title: Form inside a Card
summary: Where to put the form element so Card spacing survives.
body:
Card lays out its children with a flex column and a gap. A `<form>` placed inside Card becomes the only child, so header, content and footer lose that gap and sit flush against each other. Put the form around the Card instead.

```tsx
<form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Profile</CardTitle>
      <CardDescription>Shown to your teammates.</CardDescription>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardContent className="space-y-4">{/* form fields */}</CardContent>
    <CardFooter>
      <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
    </CardFooter>
  </Card>
</form>
```
Do not add margins to patch the gap (`mt-4` on the footer).

title: Confirm destructive action
summary: AlertDialog flow for delete and reset actions.
body:
```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger render={<Button variant="destructive">Delete account</Button>} />
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Delete your account?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>This removes your profile and data permanently.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction>Delete</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>
```
The sandbox uses Base UI, so triggers take a `render` prop instead of `asChild`. Confirm the exact API from the registry entry for alert-dialog.
